subject: RM_LureVenomvine
departures: canes are solid black from base to tip, not green or brown woody stems
fruit are pale, pearl-white and pearl-lustrous, not dark red or purple berries
each fruit is a single smooth, soft-skinned orb, not a cluster of drupelets like a blackberry
the fruit hang down singly among the canes like pendants, not held in upright clusters at branch tips
the plant forms a dense thicket of black canes, not a single bush or a trailing vine
